name: Detailed Transaction Statistics 27
definition: Information about outstanding derivatives, outstanding derivatives with no valuation and outstanding derivatives with outdated valuation.

NumberOfOutstandingDerivativesWithNoValu.name: Number Of Outstanding Derivatives With No Valuation
NumberOfOutstandingDerivativesWithNoValu.definition: Number of outstanding derivatives for which valuation amount was never reported.

NumberOfOutstandingDerivativesWithOutdat.name: Number Of Outstanding Derivatives With Outdated Valuation
NumberOfOutstandingDerivativesWithOutdat.definition: Number of outstanding derivatives with outdated valuation.

Warnings.name: Warnings
Warnings.definition: Details of outstanding derivatives for which the valuation was not reported or the valuation reported is more than fourteen calendar days earlier than the date for which the report was generated shall be included in the report of missing valuations at the end of the day.
